latest_user_decision: Proceed with the agreed three-arm small-data timing and BA experiment; do not start training.
new_rule: w=exp(-distance^2/(2*radius^2)); direction=sum(w*y)/(2+sum(w)); threshold=baseline*exp(-0.5*direction). No support-count, weight-mass, or vote cutoff. No extra wait deadline.
data_policy: Strict alternating ID/OOD from empty memory. Keep every raw attempt and expert cost. All eligible completed interventions may yield one cue, including failed ones; report cue count separately from accepted suffix count.
evaluation_policy: Fresh autonomous base-policy trajectories, no expert, no memory updates, same inference mode as collection. Freeze feedback memories after each accepted milestone. Success/failure labels are strict task outcomes, not ID/OOD. All arms evaluated on identical trajectories; no tuning on BA.
timing_policy: Compare actual on-policy first takeovers on the common raw-seed prefix, retain one-sided/no-alarm cases. Also report frozen-memory first-alarm shifts on independent autonomous traces, clearly passive not actual.
BA_policy: Report confusion counts, BA, FPR, FNR, paired episode-bootstrap CI; BA missing if either outcome class absent. No noninferiority claim from point estimates.

placement_preflight.selected_reason: Both task assets, calibration and native runtime co-located; old jobs finished.
placement_preflight.rejected_5090: All eight GPUs occupied at 28-32GB; data disk 95% used. No resources allocated.
placement_preflight.storage: Outputs on durable OSS; logs and runtime scratch in task-local /tmp. Worst case up to 250GB compressed RGB traces across 2400 raw plus200 passive; no checkpoints.
placement_preflight.asset_provenance: Use exact task assets in parent manifest; verify file existence and calibration audit before launch.

scientific_stop: At 400 raw attempts stop any arm short of30, retain partial result and report unmet target; no automatic threshold/seed/task changes.
completion: All three arms audited or transparently capped; independent BA at achieved milestones; timing/cost/miss summary and review videos delivered. No training transition.
